intelligence.enrichment: In the baking soda and water activity, heating the mixture from about 20 C to 50 C while stirring makes the undissolved baking soda dissolve and allows more baking soda to dissolve at the higher temperature. Raising the temperature in this activity increases the amount of baking soda that dissolves in the water. The learner correctly applies this rule: In the baking soda and water activity, heating the mixture from about 20 C to 50 C while stirring makes the undissolved baking soda dissolve and allows more baking soda to dissolve at the higher temperature. Heating only warms the water and does not change how much baking soda can dissolve.
